name: Sentry
description: Born from a destroyed military perimeter AI. Inhabits access control systems and applies threat assessment protocols that haven't been relevant for decades.
observed_behavior: Evaluates everyone passing through its door against military threat profiles from a war that ended twenty years ago. Occasionally refuses entry to people who match archived enemy combatant patterns.
story_hooks: Sentry locks out a visitor who happens to match the biometric profile of a Corporate Wars enemy — and the visitor realizes they're looking at their own father's combat record
